title: Generate a sverka config
description: Generates a sverka.config.ts from what the project already has (package.json scripts, Nx targets, GitHub checks).

project.description: Nx project the config describes. Default: the root project.

path.description: Where to write the config. Default: <projectRoot>/sverka.config.ts.

checks.description: Checks to include. Default: the checks detected in the project.

githubChecks.description: GitHub-side checks to add to a repo-health pipeline.
